title: Container Report - Week 33
summary:
Container
Liner freight rates remained firm over the past week with gains across most of the major east-west trades. The transpacific market once again led the advance, with FBX01 (China/East Asia - US West Coast) rising by $410 week-on-week to $7,422. Strength was also evident on the US East Coast route where FBX03 gained $288 to finish the week at $9,432.
